title: Quad set
subtitle: Tighten the front of your thigh

cues.heading: Support your leg
cues.text: Lie comfortably with your exercise leg supported and straight.

cues.heading: Tighten your thigh
cues.text: Pull your toes towards you and tighten the front of your thigh.

cues.heading: Press gently down
cues.text: Gently press the back of your knee towards the bed.

cues.heading: Relax the muscle
cues.text: Release the squeeze and let the thigh relax completely.

cues.heading: Keep breathing
cues.text: Keep your heel supported. Breathe normally throughout the squeeze.

cues.heading: Follow your plan
cues.text: Use the hold time and repetitions in your prescribed exercise plan.
